title: FIFA Football 2004
statusNote: With the N-Gage libraries on the card: language flags, EA Sports logo, title, main menu, a friendly (teams, kit, line-up, controls diagram) and the match plays with pause menu and instant replay. The dump as stored has no System/Libs, and without GAMECOMMS.DLL the app exits at launch ("Can't find GAMECOMMS.DLL", a System error dialog, no screen).
notes: The game opens on five flags for the language; the blinking one is selected, OK confirms.
Menus show their own key hints: 5 selects (OK works too), 7 goes back.
Multiplayer Mode needs Bluetooth and cannot work here.

controls.source: The game's own Game Controls diagram, shown before kick-off (controls preset "FIFA 2004"). Moving, pass, shoot, instant replay and the pause menu were confirmed in a match.

actions.left: Move player; change a menu value
actions.right: Move player; change a menu value
actions.5: Shoot (with the ball); conservative tackle (without); select (menus)
actions.7: Pass (with the ball); switch player (without); back (menus)

notes: Football layout: move on the arrows; A sprints, S passes, D shoots, F lobs, R shows the replay; Escape opens the pause menu.
On a gamepad A shoots and selects, B passes and goes back, X lobs, Y shows the replay, the right shoulder or trigger sprints, Start pauses.
